High-contrast rounded numerals and configurable data for compatible Garmin MIP watches. Free to use, with no subscription or developer account.

• 94 settings and 28 data choices. Customize or hide data areas, fonts, sizes, units, charts and progress indicators.
• The watch face and settings support Simplified Chinese and English. Other watch languages use English.
• 12/24-hour time, light/dark themes and optional seconds. The cleaner default layout shows Body Battery when available; decorative cards, moon phase, wind arrow and activity indicators can be enabled or disabled.
• Heart rate, steps, calories, altitude, weather and battery data depend on the watch and Garmin's system caches. Missing values show --. This face does not activate GPS.
• Decorative cards do not provide transit, access or payment functions. Preview images use simulated data.

Watch data stays on the device; the developer does not collect or upload health or location data. Independently developed, not affiliated with Garmin.

1.2.0
• Rounded numerals and a cleaner default layout, with Body Battery in the right-hand data area.
• Retains all 94 settings, 28 data choices and the Chinese/English watch interface.
• Preserves custom card and data choices during the visual upgrade.
• Improves memory handling when saving settings and keeps tiny chart digits distinct.

A retro world-map watch face with digital time, an analogue dial and 16 map styles. Shows weather, sunrise and sunset times, and day/night shading. Free, with no subscription or developer account.

• 21 settings and nine configurable data areas. Choose 12/24-hour time and whether to show seconds, the map and the location marker.
• Text on the watch face always stays English. Settings are available in English and Simplified Chinese.
• On supported MIP watches, digital seconds can update once per second. AMOLED always-on uses a dim display refreshed once per minute. Support depends on the watch and firmware.
• Reads cached weather and location without activating GPS. Optional manual coordinates affect the map and sunrise/sunset calculations, not weather.

Missing data shows --. Data stays on the watch; the developer does not collect or upload health or location data. Preview images use simulated data. Independently developed, not affiliated with Garmin.
